subject: Feature prioritization: Olympus Dedicated routing + audit logs (deal-impact)
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@olympus-fin.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Feature prioritization request — Olympus Dedicated routing + audit logs (deal-impact)

Team,

Quick ask from the field: Olympus has escalated two technical requirements that procurement is citing as blockers for signature:

1) Tenant-aware routing / region pinning: ability to ensure traffic for Olympus is routed to a dedicated GPU pool in the us-west region (or a named pool) and an explicit API/config option to pin routes to that pool.
2) Audit log retention & export: 90-day retention for audit logs with a documented S3-compatible export process (they want to dump logs into their S3).

They want these items referenced as capabilities in the contract (they're OK with "limited preview / enterprise preview" language, but need an ETA and acceptance criteria). Olympus is a high-probability close (~$1.2M ARR Y1). Procurement made clear they will not advance to legal without a written technical commitment.

Attached: mutual action plan and their security questionnaire for context.

What I need: realistic scope, acceptance criteria we can put in the MPA (or propose a preview clause), and an ETA in weeks. Also call out anything Sales should explicitly NOT promise (e.g., GA timelines, SLA numbers). If we need a temporary workaround (manual export, dedicated VLAN), call that out so I can present options.

Proposed commercial fallback if we miss ETA: one quarter of credits + hands-on onboarding support.

Thanks — I know this is tight. Please respond with your best assessment so I can update the MPA by Tuesday.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Feature prioritization request — Olympus Dedicated routing + audit logs (deal-impact)

Aisha — quick clarifying questions before Eng/Product scope:

- For tenant-aware routing, does Olympus need per-tenant physical isolation (dedicated pool) or logical pinning to an existing dedicated pool? They mentioned "pin to a dedicated pool / region."
- For audit logs: do they require audited integrity (signed logs) or just export + retention? Are there retention encryption/key requirements in the questionnaire?

If we can get those answers I can sketch a commercial fallback (e.g., dedicated tenant pool + manual daily export). Olivia, can you confirm?

Thanks,
Dylan

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Feature prioritization request — Olympus Dedicated routing + audit logs (deal-impact)

Folks — engineering assessment below (high-level, non-binding):

Tenant-aware routing (MVP):
- Option A (fastest): add an API param (tenant_pool_id) and routing table to prefer matching requests to a named Dedicated pool. This assumes the pool already exists; minimal infra change. Ballpark: 4-6 weeks to ship as "enterprise preview" (no UI), includes API + routing config + test harness.
- Option B (full isolation): provisioning workflow + onboarding automation to create per-tenant pools and network isolation — 10-12+ weeks, larger ops cost.

Audit log retention & S3 export:
- Export pipeline: scheduled job that pushes audit logs to a customer S3 endpoint (S3-compatible) with configurable retention policy. We already have internal export hooks; work required to parameterize endpoints and retention. Ballpark: 3-4 weeks for export pipeline beta, 6 weeks for retention policy management and documentation.
- Risks: export needs secure credentials handling (we should use presigned URLs or customer-managed role). Also migration of historical logs into 90-day retention window may require backfill if we haven't retained that long.

Compatibility notes:
- Adding tenant_pool_id param is backward compatible (defaults to current routing).
- Audit export will require schema versioning for log format; consumer (Olympus) must accept current schema or we need a transformation layer.

Resource ask: 1 full stack engineer + 0.5 infra engineer for the initial 6 weeks to hit the MVP timelines above.

If Product wants to truncate scope (e.g., API-only without export UI), we can compress timelines by ~1-2 weeks.

— Dev
Senior Backend Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Feature prioritization request — Olympus Dedicated routing + audit logs (deal-impact)

Thanks Dev — summary from Product POV and suggested path to satisfy procurement quickly: 

Proposed minimal commitment we can put in MPA (enterprise preview language):
- Tenant-aware routing (enterprise preview): Redwood will provide an API parameter to route traffic to a specified Dedicated pool (tenant_pool_id). Preview to be available to Olympus within 6-8 weeks. Acceptance criteria: documented API, routing verified on test traffic, and one successful pilot with production-like throughput.
- Audit logs (export): Redwood will provide scheduled S3-compatible export of audit logs with a 90-day retention target. Preview export pipeline available within 4 weeks; full operationalization (config UI + documented backfill path) within 8 weeks. Acceptance criteria: successful export to Olympus S3, documented schema, and security review pass.

Guardrails / things Sales SHOULD NOT promise:
- Do not promise GA SLA or uptime numbers for these features in the MPA. Mark as "enterprise preview" and include rollback/fallback options.
- Do not commit to backfilling beyond 90 days unless we explicitly scope the effort.

If procurement insists on stronger wording, we can offer an "onboarding assurance" commitment: priority onboarding and a named RM, plus a limited service credit if preview acceptance tests are not met within X weeks. That should be sufficient commercially without changing engineering commitments.

Next steps: Aisha, if you confirm Olympus will accept "enterprise preview" language, I'll draft the precise MPA clause and the acceptance test steps.

— Neha
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@olympus-fin.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Procurements Team <procurements@olympus-fin.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Olympus procurement — proposed MPA language and ask (finalizing)

Olivia / Procurement team — thank you for the call today. Per our internal alignment, we can commit to an enterprise preview path that we would like to include in the MPA. Below is the proposed language for your review: 

"Redwood Inference will provide Olympus Financial with an enterprise preview of tenant-aware routing (API parameter to pin traffic to a specified Dedicated pool) and an S3-exportable audit log pipeline with a 90-day retention target. Redwood estimates availability of the routing preview within 6-8 weeks and audit export preview within 4 weeks from execution of the MPA. Acceptance criteria: documented API, successful export to customer S3 endpoint, and a pilot validation run. These preview features will be provided under an "enterprise preview" program and are not covered by GA SLAs. If Redwood fails to meet the preview acceptance criteria within the stated window, Redwood will provide a service credit equal to one month of committed service and dedicated onboarding support.

"

Please confirm if this language is acceptable for procurement/legal to proceed. If Olympus needs stronger contractual guarantees (GA timeline or uptime), we will need to scope a separate paid engineering commitment.

I've attached the updated MPA and the security questionnaire with our notes.

Thanks — hoping to close this week.

— Aisha
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: OMA_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf, Olympus_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
